scene-u01-pnew12-4.name: text#4
scene-u01-pnew12-4.text: Relevance feedback: a few user labels teach the system what is similar, and which images to show for labeling matters

scene-u01-pnew12-6.name: text#6
scene-u01-pnew12-6.text: Samples far from the boundary show relevant results sooner; samples near it make the classifier learn faster; a mixed strategy does both.

scene-u01-pnew12-12.name: text#12
scene-u01-pnew12-12.text: Retrieve a batch similar to the query by $l_p$ distance

scene-u01-pnew12-15.name: text#15
scene-u01-pnew12-15.text: Mark retrieved images relevant or not

scene-u01-pnew12-18.name: text#18
scene-u01-pnew12-18.text: Train a binary classifier on the labels (often SVM)

scene-u01-pnew12-22.name: text#22
scene-u01-pnew12-22.text: Repeat steps 2–3 until the user is satisfied

scene-u01-pnew12-156.name: text#156
scene-u01-pnew12-156.text: Black line: boundary; orange circles: simple strategy ($8$ relevant); blue squares: active learning ($3$ relevant); triangles: initial labels

scene-u01-pnew12-180.name: text#180
scene-u01-pnew12-180.text: Synthetic data, logistic regression instead of SVM; not a replication of source Figure 8.16
